name: visualize-skills
description: Three skills, one house style: visualize-the-problem diagrams a confirmed bug/incident root cause, visualize-the-plan diagrams a proposed fix before you build it, and visualize-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task — instead of walls of text at each stage. Built for vibe coders who lose track of what's wrong, what's proposed, or what an AI agent changed. Renders self-contained dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagrams with a clickable glossary for jargon.
